# mifarepy

> Typed Python library (Python 3.9+, LGPL-3.0-or-later, depends only on pyserial) for MIFARE Classic 1K/4K cards on GIGA-TMS / PROMAG readers (PCR310U, MF5, MF10) that speak the GNetPlus serial protocol at 19200 baud 8N1.

Install with `pip install mifarepy`. Import everything from the package root: `from mifarepy import MifareReader, SectorAuth, CardInfo, GNetPlusError, InvalidMessage, layout`.

Key facts for correct code:

- Use `with MifareReader.auto() as reader:` to find the reader, or `MifareReader('/dev/ttyUSB0')` (Windows: `'COM3'`). The context manager closes the port and turns auto mode off.
- Tests without hardware: `MifareReader.simulated(SimulatedCard(...))` (`from mifarepy.simulator import SimulatedCard`), or the pytest fixtures `mifare_reader`, `mifare_card`, `mifare_simulator` that mifarepy registers automatically.
- Debugging: `mifarepy.enable_wire_trace()` logs every frame (keys hidden) on the `mifarepy.wire` logger.
- Card detection: `get_uid()` returns `'0xAABBCCDD'`; `get_uid_int()`; `scan_tag()` returns `CardInfo`; `is_card_present()`; `wait_for_card(timeout)`; `await wait_for_card_async(timeout)`. `get_sn()` is deprecated.
- Authenticate before every read/write: `reader.authenticate_sector(sector, key: bytes(6), key_type='A'|'B')`. The factory default key is `bytes.fromhex('FFFFFFFFFFFF')`.
- Block numbers for `read_block()` / `write_block()` are RELATIVE to the authenticated sector (0-3, or 0-15 for 4K sectors 32-39). Use `mifarepy.layout` to convert to/from absolute block numbers.
- `read_sector()` / `write_sector()` cover data blocks only and never write the sector trailer. `read_blocks()` / `write_blocks()` work across sectors with `auth={sector: SectorAuth(key=..., key_type='A')}`.
- Value blocks: `create_value_block()`, `read_value()`, `write_value()`, `increment_value()`, `decrement_value()`, `transfer()`, `restore()`. Increment/decrement use read-modify-write; transfer/restore use native RESTORE/TRANSFER, verified by reading back, with automatic fallback. `MifareReader(..., value_ops='native')` also sends SET_VALUE for increment/decrement (wrong on PCR310U firmware PGM0487 V1.4R0); `'software'` uses no native commands.
- Errors: reader NAKs raise subclasses of `GNetPlusError` (`NoCardError`, `AuthenticationError`, `NotAuthenticatedError`, `CardReadError`, `CardWriteError`, `ValueBlockError`, `CardTimeoutError`, `ReaderProtocolError`, `ReaderAccessError`), each with `.hint`; port problems raise `ReaderConnectionError` / `ReaderNotFoundError` (both `RuntimeError`). Base class `GNetPlusError` with `.nak_code` (int) and `.code_description` (e.g. 0x04 "Authentication error", 0x1F "No tag in field"); malformed frames raise `InvalidMessage`.
- Raw commands: `reader.sendmsg(QueryMessage.<NAME>, payload)` then `reader.readmsg()`.

## Docs

- [Usage guide](https://sparkdrago05.github.io/mifarepy/latest/usage/): every feature with examples
- [API reference](https://sparkdrago05.github.io/mifarepy/latest/api/): generated from docstrings
- [MIFARE Classic primer](https://sparkdrago05.github.io/mifarepy/latest/mifare-classic/): layout, keys, access bits, value blocks
- [GNetPlus protocol reference](https://sparkdrago05.github.io/mifarepy/latest/protocol/): frames, CRC, command and error-code tables
- [Testing without hardware](https://sparkdrago05.github.io/mifarepy/latest/testing/): simulator and pytest fixtures
- [Hardware & setup](https://sparkdrago05.github.io/mifarepy/latest/hardware/): ports, permissions, troubleshooting

## Optional

- [Examples](https://github.com/SparkDrago05/mifarepy/tree/main/examples): nine runnable scripts
